senses.gloss: न्यक् न्यक्, न्य्-अक्ष. See col. 3.

न्यग्रोध न्यग्-रोध. See under 2. न्य्-अञ्च्,
col. 3.

न्यच्छ न्यच्छ, अम्, n. a mole or spot upon
the body.

न्यञ्च् 1. न्य्-अञ्च्, cl. 1. P. A. -अचति or -अञ्-
चति, -अञ्चितुम्, Ved. to bend down, curve down.

2. न्य्-अञ्च्, न्यङ्, नीची, न्यक् [cf. नीच, p. 512],
going downwards, turned or directed downwards, bent
down; lying on the face; low, vile, contemptible,
base; whole, entire; slow, lazy; नीचा, inst. c. on the
ground, (see p. 512, col. 1); (न्यक्), ind. downwards,
down, humbly.
—न्यग्-जाति, इस्, इस्, इ, of a low or
inferior race, low born.
—न्यग्-रोध, अस्, m. (=
न्यक्-रोह, growing downwards), the Indian fig-tree,
Ficus Indica; another tree [cf. शमी]; a fathom,
measured by the arms extended; N. of a son of
Ugra-sena; of a Brāhman, of a monastery, of a village;
(ई or आ), f. Salvinia Cucculata; a medicinal plant
(commonly Mohānā).
—न्यग्रोध-परिमण्डल,
अस्, आ, अम्, being a fathom in circumference; (आ), f.
an elegant woman.
—न्यग्रोध-पाद, अस्, m., N.
of a man.

न्यक्-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to make low,
lower, humble, humiliate, degrade, treat with dis-
respect or contempt, slight.
—न्यक्-करण, अम्,
n. the act of lowering or degrading, treating with
disrespect or contempt.
—न्यक्-कार, अस्, m. making
low, humiliation, humbling, contempt, disregard, dis-
respect.
—न्यक्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, humbled, treated
with contempt or contumely.

न्याकृ न्य्-आ-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्,
Ved. to keep back, hold back.

न्य्-अक्न, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. bent down.
—न्यक्-
नाङ्गुलि (˚न-अङ्˚), इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. having the
fingers bent.

न्य्-अक्ष, अस्, आ, अम् [cf. rt. अक्ष्, which may be
connected with rt. अच् = अञ्च्], low, inferior; whole,
entire; (अस्), m. a buffalo; an epithet of Paraśu-
rāma; (अम्), n. the whole; grass.

न्यग्-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, &c., to become low
or humble, to humble one's self: Caus. न्यग्-भाव-
यति, to cause to become low, humiliate, treat with
disrespect.
—न्यग्-भाव, अस्, m. humiliation, degra-
dation, debasement, contempt.
—न्यग्-भावन,
अम्, n. humbling, degrading, treating with contempt,
defiling.
—न्यग्-भावयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who
lowers or humbles; humbling.
न्य्-अङ्क, अस्, m. a particular part of a carriage.

न्य्-अङ्कु, उस्, m. a deer, an antelope; N. of a
Muni; of a Cakra-vartin.
—न्यङ्कु-भूरुह, अस्,
m. the tree Calosanthes Indica.
—न्यङ्कु-शिरस्,
scil. ककुभ्, a sort of metre consisting of 11 + 12
+ 4 syllables.
—न्यङ्कु-सारिणी, f., scil. बृहती, f. a
sort of metre, also called उरो-बृहती, consisting of
8 + 12 + 8 + 8 syllables.

न्य्-अञ्चित, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown or cast down,
bent down.

न्यञ्ज् न्य्-अञ्ज्, cl. 7. P. -अनक्ति (Ved. also
A. -अङ्क्ते), -अञ्जितुम् or -अङ्क्तुम्, to anoint, be-
smear; (A.) to creep in, to conceal or hide one's self.
न्य्-अक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, anointed, smeared; mixed up.

न्य्-अङ्ग, अस्, m. a mark, sign; sort, kind (e. g.
अवभृथ-न्यङ्ग, a sort of Avabhṛtha); (अम्),
n. low abuse (?).

न्यञ्जलिका न्य्-अञ्जलिका, f. an Añjali which
is directed downwards.

न्यन्त न्य्-अन्त, m. n. (?), proximity; (एन),
ind., Ved. near, near to.

न्यय न्य्-अय, अस्, m. (fr. 3. नी, i. e. rt. 5. इ
with नि), destruction, loss, waste.

न्याय न्य्-आय, अस्, m. (fr. 3. नी, i. e. rt. 5. इ
with नि), method, way, rule (lit. that to which any-
thing goes back or in which anything goes), model,
manner, system, plan, doctrine, right or fit or suitable
manner, that which is fitting, fitness, propriety,
right, justice, virtue, equity, law, a lawful act; (in
gram.) a general or universal rule, an axiom which
precedes and must be kept in view in the explanation
of special rules; a lawsuit, policy, good government;
decision in a lawsuit, judicial sentence, judgment; a
celebrated system of Hindū philosophy delivered by
Gautama or Gotama in a set of aphorisms divided
into five lectures; the proper way of stating an argu-
ment, logic, logical philosophy; a logical argument,
a complete argument or syllogism (consisting of five
members with the Naiyāyikas, viz. प्रतिज्ञा, हेतु,
उदाहरण, उपनय, निगमन, and of three
members with the Vedāntins); likeness, analogy,
apposite illustration; न्यायेन, in the way of, after
the manner of (e. g. लीला-न्यायेन, by way of sport, as
if in sport; cf. न्याय-तस् below). Placed after a
finite verb न्यायम् is said by Pāṇini (VIII. 1, 27,
57) to express either censure or repetition.
—न्याय-
कल्पलतिका, f., N. of a commentary.
—न्याय-कुसु-
माञ्जलि, इस्, m., N. of the aphorisms of Udayana;
[cf. कुसुमाञ्जलि.]
—न्याय-कोकिल (?), अस्, m.,
N. of a Buddhist teacher.
—न्याय-कौस्तुभ,
अम्, n., N. of a general work on the Nyāya
philosophy.
—न्याय-चूडा-मणि, N. of a confuta-
tion of the Nyāya system of philosophy in favour
of the Vedānta by Mādhava Sarasvatī.
—न्याय-
चूडामणि-प्रभा, f., N. of a commentary on the
preceding work by Caṇḍīśvara.
—न्याय-तस्, ind.
in a fitting manner, as is fitting; suitably, justly, fitly,
according to right or justice.
—न्याय-ता, f. or न्याय-
त्व, अम्, n. fitness, propriety.
—न्याय-द्वार-तार-
क-शास्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Buddhist work.
—न्याय-
पञ्चानन, अस्, m. an epithet of Jaya-rāma; [cf.
पञ्चानन.]
—न्याय-बिन्दु, N. of a commentary
on the Mīmāṃsā-sūtras by Vaidya-nātha.
—न्याय-
बोधिनी, f., N. of a commentary on the Tarka-
saṅgraha by Go-vardhana Miśra.
—न्याय-भाष्य,
अम्, n., N. of a commentary on the Nyāya-sūtras
by the Ṛṣi Vātsyāyana.
—न्याय-भास्कर, N. of
a philosophical work.
—न्याय-भूषण, अम्, n.,
N. of a work.
—न्याय-मकरन्द, N. of a work
on the Nyāya system controverted from the stand-
point of the Vedānta.
—न्याय-माला-विस्तर, अस्,
m., N. of an introduction to the study of the
Mīmāṃsā philosophy.
—न्याय-रत्नमाला, f., N.
of a work on the Mīmāṃsā.
—न्याय-लीलावती, N.
of an elementary treatise on the Nyāya philosophy.
—न्याय-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, acting rightly, behaving
properly.
—न्याय-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, well behaved,
acting with propriety.
—न्याय-वागीश, अस्, m. an
epithet of Śrī-kṛṣṇa; of Dīkṣita-śrī-kaṇṭha-śarman.
—न्याय-विहित, अस्, आ, अम्, prescribed by rule.
—न्याय-शास्त्र, अम्, n. the philosophical system
of the Nyāya school; logic (as connected with this
school).
—न्याय-सङ्क्षेप, अस्, m. or न्याय-
सङ्ग्रह, अस्, m. or न्याय-सार, अस् or अम्, m. or
n., N. of certain compendious works on the Nyāya
philosophy.
—न्याय-सारिणी, f. right or fit behaviour;
a woman acting or judging rightly.
—न्याय-सिद्-
धान्त-पञ्चानन, अस्, m. an epithet of Viśva-
nātha.
—न्यायसिद्धान्त-मञ्जरी, f., N. of a
work.
—न्याय-सूत्र, अम्, n. the aphorisms of the
Nyāya philosophy by Gautama.
—न्यायाचार (˚य-
आच्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, acting justly, virtuous.
—न्याया-
धार (˚य-आध्˚), अस्, m. ‘receptacle of justice,’ a
term applied to any one who is a model of virtue or
propriety.
—न्यायानुसार-शास्त्र (˚य-अन्˚), अम्,
n., N. of a Buddhist work.
—न्यायामृत (˚य-
अम्˚), अम्, n. ‘nectar of Nyāya,’ N. of a Vedānta
work by Vyāsa Tīrtha Bindu.
—न्यायामृत-त-
रङ्गिनी, f., N. of a commentary on the Nyāyāmṛta
by Rāma Ācārya.
—न्यायार्जित (˚य-अर्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, obtained in a regular way.
—न्यायालङ्कार-
[]
भट्ट (˚य-अल्˚), अस्, m. an epithet of Śrī-
govinda; also of Śrī-maheśvara.
—न्यायावली-दी-
धिति (˚य-आव्˚), इस्, f., N. of a commentary on
Jaimini.
—न्यायोपेत (˚य-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, accord-
ing to rule, right, admitted.

न्याय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, regular, proper, just, right,
equitable, fit, suitable, adapted, (sometimes giving a
passive sense to the infin.); usual, customary.
—न्याय्-
य-त्व, अम्, n. fitness, suitableness, propriety.
न्य्-अयन, अम्, n., Ved. entrance or receptacle.

न्यर्ण न्य्-अर्ण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. अर्द् or rt.
4. ऋ with नि), dissolved (Ved.); injured; asked,
solicited (?); gone (?).

न्यर्थ न्य्-अर्थ, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 4. ऋ with नि),
Ved. destruction, annihilation; (Sāy. on Ṛg-veda
VII. 18, 9) not going in the usual course.
न्यर्पय न्य्-अर्पय, Caus. of न्य्-ऋ, q. v.

न्यर्बुद न्य्-अर्बुद, अम्, n., Ved. one hundred
millions.

न्यर्बुदि न्य्-अर्बुदि, इस्, m., N. of a divine
being described as taking an active part in war.

न्यवग्रह न्य्-अवग्रह, अस्, m. the accentless
vowel at the end of a Pūrva-pada.

न्यवचर् न्य्-अव-चर्, cl. 1. P. -चरति, -च-
रितुम्, to enter into, penetrate.

न्यस् न्य्-अस्, cl. 4. P. -अस्यति, -असितुम्, to
throw down, cast down, lay down, set or put down
(with loc., e. g. भूमौ, on the ground); to lay
down, resign, give up (e. g. जीवितं न्य्-अस्, to lay
down one's life); to bring forward, adduce, pro-
pound (as an argument &c.); to lay or put down or
place upon anything (with loc., e. g. चित्रे न्य्-अस्, to
place in a picture, paint, depict; पथि न्य्-अस्, to lay
down on the road, give up an occupation, &c.; शिरस्य्
आज्ञां न्य्-अस्, to place a command on one's head,
i. e. receive a command with due reverence; शापम्
मयि न्यस्यति, he lays a curse upon me); to put
in, place within (with loc.), to deposit with any one
(loc.); to give into any one's keeping, make a de-
posit, intrust, deliver, consign, commit; to settle, fix,
appoint; to support: Caus. न्य्-आसयति, to cause to
put or lay down, &c.

न्य्-असन, अम्, n. casting or laying down, de-
positing; delivering, giving up.

न्य्-अस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown or cast down, laid
down, placed in or upon, put in, inserted, applied;
delivered, deposited, consigned; depicted (e. g. चित्र-
न्यस्त, committed to a picture, painted); rested
on, leaning, resting; given up, resigned, set aside.
—न्यस्त-दण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘laying down the
rod,’ giving up all means of punishment.
—न्यस्त-
देह, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has laid down the body,
dead.
—न्यस्त-शस्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has
laid down or resigned his weapons, laying down
arms; unarmed, defenceless; harmless; epithet of
the Manes or deified progenitors.

1. न्य्-अस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be deposited; to be ap-
pointed to any office (with loc.); to be delivered.

2. न्य्-अस्य, ind. having put down, having laid
down, having deposited, having given up, &c.

न्य्-आस, अस्, m. putting down, placing, settling,
planting or putting down (the feet), stepping, a
step; depositing; a deposit, pledge; delivering,
intrusting, committing, delivery; putting on colour
&c., painting; writing down, writing, impress, stamp,
mark; giving up, putting off or away, laying aside;
deserting, abandoning; lowering the tone of the
voice; bringing forward, adducing; striking or digging
in (the claws &c.), seizing (with the claws); con-
signing or intrusting anything to the mind; mental
appropriation or assignment of various parts of the
body to tutelary divinities (accompanied with certain
prayers and gesticulations); N. of a commentary on
the Kāśikā-vṛtti by Jinendra.
—न्यास-धारिन्, ई,
m. the holder of a deposit, a mortgagee.
—न्यासा-
पह्नव (˚स-अप्˚), अस्, m. repudiation of a deposit.
—न्यासी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-
तुम्, to make a deposit, deposit anything with a
person.
—न्यासोद्द्योत (˚स-उद्˚), अस्, m., N. of a
grammatical work.
न्यास न्य्-आस. See under न्य्-अस्, col. 1.

न्य्-आसिन्, ई, इनी, इ, one who has abandoned all
worldly concerns; (ई), m. a Sannyāsī.
न्यह्न न्य्-अह्न (?), Ved. the closing day.
न्याक्य न्याक्य, अम्, n. fried rice.

न्याग्रोधमूल न्याग्रोधमूल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr.
न्यग्रोध-मूल), being or situated at the roots of
the Ficus Indica.

न्याद न्याद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. अद् with नि),
eating, feeding.

न्याधा न्य्-आ-धा, cl. 3. P. -दधाति, -धा-
तुम्, to fix in, place in, appoint; to put down.
न्यायिन्, ई, इनी, ई, right, fit; logical, rational.

न्याव्यध् न्य्-आ-व्यध्, cl. 4. P. -विध्यति,
-व्यद्धुम्, to cause to burst forth, let loose, set free.
